ratings.name: Hevy
limitations: Android-facing publisher artwork; depicted OS and version unknown. Light visual evidence only.
Enlarged completed rows, chart and routine card excluded from native-layout ratings.
No exercised input, dark theme, running countdown, open keyboard or separate history detail; missing coverage does not imply missing features.
adopt: Label previous results separately from current KG and Reps.
Distinguish a named routine Start action from quieter creation utilities.
avoid: Very faint unfinished-set values that resemble disabled content.
Metric or exploration choices competing with the personal workout launcher.

ratings.name: Strong
limitations: Android-style chrome in publisher artwork; no installed build exercised and content date/version unknown.
Light caret and lower input/plate area do not verify keyboard behavior.
Enlarged progress chart excluded from native-layout ratings; its estimated-1RM label is not actual per-set history.
History is only a navigation label in the supplied material.
adopt: Align previous and current numeric data without paragraph parsing.
Use bounded input cells, an explicit focus treatment and differentiated completed rows across both themes.
Keep time status near the ongoing logging task.
avoid: Estimated-1RM dashboard and custom plate-entry complexity for Rebuild.

ratings.name: Fitbod
limitations: Android-style publisher artwork, dark only in this packet; date/version unknown.
Completion gesture cannot be established by numbered markers and outlined fields.
History and rest are unopened affordances; no keyboard, running countdown or optional-RIR input shown.
Strength scores are not raw logged weight/reps; homepage HTTP 403 was not bypassed.
adopt: Emphasize the current field pair while retaining completed and future context.
Pair exercise names with concise sets/reps/load summaries.
avoid: Large instructional photography before every logging task.
Strength-score or coaching-led framing in an actuals-only personal logger.

ratings.name: Boostcamp
limitations: Android-facing publisher artwork with unverified depicted OS; dark visuals only, unknown date/version.
RPE input and a previous-performance RIR annotation do not demonstrate optional-RIR entry.
Toolbar time is not proven to be a rest countdown.
Chart depicts volume/bodyweight, not actual per-set reps; title/illustration mismatch is illustrative-content uncertainty.
adopt: Keep Previous, Target and actual input conceptually distinct.
Name utilities and mark selected tabs visibly.
avoid: Importing all columns, annotations and utilities into Rebuild's narrow logger.
Dual-axis volume/bodyweight analysis or RPE-calculator complexity.

ratings.name: Alpha Progression
limitations: Android-facing publisher artwork with iPhone-style frame; depicted OS/date/version unverified.
Yesterday block does not establish comparability logic.
10RM display and chart are not evidence of raw load/reps history plotting.
No open keyboard, expanded timer, light visual or optional-RIR editor retained.
adopt: Use a dated prior-session block beside current logging context.
Separate selected plan day from exercise prescriptions and the explicit Save action.
avoid: Very muted prior values and thumbnail-only exercise identity.
Derived-10RM prominence, target automation assumptions and a broad chart dashboard.

ratings.name: Liftin'
limitations: iOS style comparison only; dark publisher artwork, unknown content date/version.
One-tap logging is advertising, not a measured interaction.
Enlarged timer, Add control, calendar treatment and illustrated finger excluded from native-placement scoring.
Circular rep badges leave planned/current/completed interpretation uncertain without interaction.
No keyboard, light visual, Android UI or actual load/reps time-series evidence.
adopt: Use exercise-name rows with concise numerical summaries.
Make total-load versus per-side unit meaning explicit where relevant.
avoid: Badge-only completion whose meaning relies on learned behavior.
iOS-specific chrome, plate-heavy layouts and Weight-PR-first history.

ratings.name: Rebuild 0.1.3
limitations: High confidence applies to visible native layout only, not verified interactions.
API 34 emulator at one portrait viewport; selected normal/200% states, all keyboards closed.
Synthetic partial history, no physical Galaxy A71 or TalkBack exercise by this reviewer.
200% Log set at timer boundary demonstrates viewport pressure, not proven inability to scroll or tap.
Bright bottom gesture band is visible in dark captures; cause unverified.
Semantics, persistence, timer, IME, backups and safety guards are required invariants, not inferred from photos.
adopt: Preserve dominant Start/Log set actions and explicit actual kg/reps/optional-RIR entry.
Preserve workout/phase/exercise/count/rest orientation and dated read-first history.
Keep rounded-outline icons, system-aware themes and dark charcoal/amber identity.
avoid: Prose-heavy previous-set comparison and repetitive supporting-action spacing.
Broad beige/tan/brown light treatment and an unexplained bright gesture-band break in dark.
Removing guards, auto-logging, automatic phase progression or importing competitor dashboards.

rebuild_dark: Preserve surface #171410 and primary #E6C27A, unboxed structure and rounded-outline icons. Refine data hierarchy without recoloring the identity; investigate the visible bright gesture-band discontinuity without assuming its cause.
rebuild_light: Retain system-aware light mode. Neutralize light canvas, containers and outlines; use dark ink and trial dark-ink primary actions with restrained amber selection details instead of pervasive beige/brown. Validate semantic contrast and all component states before adopting exact colors.
top_changes: Replace Last comparable prose with dated labeled set lines beside entry; preserve matching logic, actuals, RIR, provenance and large-font reflow.
Retune light semantic colors only; contrast-check real states and keep dark charcoal/amber unchanged.
Clarify the persistent rest strip with visible wrapping add-time/skip labels and secondary alerts status; protect IME, landscape, timer persistence and accessibility guards.
Tighten repetitive help/target spacing rather than fonts or touch targets; preserve one-tap prefill, no auto-save, warm-up distinction, edits, recovery and baseline/current/optional-upper caps.
Quiet repeated home/history support actions while retaining manual phase choice, explicit actual-log correction, scope distinctions and backup safety.
uncertainties: Ratings are an independent expert judgment of bounded visible evidence, not consensus, a user study or an exhaustive market ranking.
All six visual dimensions are evidenced for all seven rows; no missing behavior is scored as zero.
Strong is the most transferable reference in this assessment, not a universally best product.
Reasonable reviewers may prefer Alpha Progression's prior-session block to Strong's comparative table, or more spacing to more density.
Publisher images cannot establish actual target sizes, dynamic text, keyboard behavior, persistence, semantics, one-handed reach or measured tap counts.
References were collected 2026-09-27, but their content dates/versions are unknown; missing light or dark evidence is not absence of support.
No enlarged promotional callout is treated as proof of an in-app control's size or location.
